event_summary: A suspended black kettlebell and a suspended green sheet descend onto two gray pillows, with the pillows changing shape where contact occurs.
raw_event_description: The video shows two light gray pillows side by side on a wooden tabletop against a wall. A black kettlebell hangs above the left pillow from a dark vertical strap, and a green rectangular sheet hangs above the right pillow from a blue-and-black hanging element. After an initial still period, the kettlebell moves downward toward the left pillow and comes to rest on its top surface. The left pillow visibly dents and changes contour around the kettlebell. The green sheet also moves downward toward the right pillow, tilts from a more vertical orientation to a flatter orientation, and ends lying partly on the right pillow while its hanging element remains above it. The final view holds with both suspended items in contact with the pillows.

reasons: The two pillows are fully visible on the tabletop.
The hanging kettlebell and the green sheet are visible, but their upper suspension points extend out of frame.
